text: The paper's target causal chain is delivery -> situated recipient judgment -> responsibility-safe role evidence -> future assignment -> unseen quality/cost.
The current protocol separates typed observation from producer attribution and delayed policy credit.
The current PIPE2 runtime replay has 40 valid receipts but no complete recipient judgment, consumer action, or terminal outcome, so every case remains UNKNOWN.
The current baseline parity card is a design-only zero-call qualification and cannot support a scientific comparison.
The canonical AAMAS PDF is reproducible as an internal revision with eight body pages and references beginning on page nine, while submission readiness remains false.
